title: Return a global empirical lower certificate without claiming future fidelity
statement: Recorded product-probe data compress into35 homogeneous-quartic coefficients. The controller returns a rational rotation and exact global lower certificate when the verified SOS branch closes; an uncapped complete finite grid is the all-input fallback. A point cap returns failure. Generic fixed-template expected-bit polynomial construction is a separate theorem, not a finished generic four-variable implementation. Every approximate-oracle and timing/randomness cost remains paid.

requires: Actual35-coefficient rational quartic from the recorded probes, unit-quaternion rotation constraint and requested certificate tolerance
Same60,000-call acquisition bank with29,916 probes and actual final retained bath; evaluator truth is not controller input
Complete role-private source-memory CP maps, canonical reset decoder, trusted buffers/endpoints and existing outer code

assumptions: Exact empirical optimality is not future physical fidelity or an acquired stationarity promise. The generic four-variable resultant template is not a completed generic solver implementation; finite SOS successes do not prove a fast worst-case oracle. Candidate-dependent runtime needs source-clock padding/isolation. The60,000-call retained-bank comparison is counterfactual from one actual final bath, not repeated sequential reset operations. Ordinary SLSQP gives identical rational candidates/yield and Nelder-Mead is comparable. No unique solver advantage, hardware or total-cost superiority.
